title: Add job role creation page

requirements.text: Create a new frontend page at route '/admin/add-job-role' that allows admins to add new job roles using the existing JobRoleForm component

quotes: add a page to adding job roles

acceptanceCriteria: New route '/admin/add-job-role' is accessible from the admin navigation
Page uses the existing JobRoleForm component in create mode
Page is protected with AdminGuard component
Successful job role creation redirects to the admin panel
Page has appropriate header and layout consistent with existing admin pages

requirements.text: Add a navigation link or button in the AdminPanel page that directs users to the new job role creation page
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation element is clearly labeled (e.g., 'Add New Job Role' or 'Create Job Role')
Link/button is visually prominent and easy to find

requirements.text: Update the App.tsx routing configuration to include the new job role creation page route
acceptanceCriteria: Route is properly registered in the router configuration
Route follows existing admin route patterns
Route is accessible only when authenticated and authorized as admin

constraints: Do not modify the existing JobRoleForm component implementation
Must use AdminGuard to protect the new page from unauthorized access
Follow the existing routing patterns in App.tsx
Maintain consistency with current admin panel styling and layout
nonGoals: Changing the backend job role creation logic
Adding bulk job role import features
Implementing job role templates or presets
